newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura shares climb on profit report.
newsitem.headline: Nomura shares climb on profit report.

text.p: Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd rose on Monday following a newspaper report that it was the most profitable brokerage in Japan in April despite a recent scandal concerning illegal stock deals, brokers said.
At midday, the shares were up 40 yen at 1,450 with the third-heaviest turnover on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange of 1.99 million shares.

"There had been a barrage of news after the scandal that firms were halting business with the brokerage, but the report shows that the damage to Nomura's business may not be as big as envisaged," a broker at a medium-sized brokerage said.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said over the weekend that Nomura made a profit of 29.2 billion yen in April, making it the most profitable brokerage.
It was followed by Daiwa Securities Co Ltd with a profit of 11 billion yen.
